description.shortText: Utilizing IoT and connected motion sensors, largescale events and historical attractions can be well managed through real-time monitoring. By allowing for the monitoring of traffic patterns in events, historical sites, etc. the technology can identify which areas are the busiest and distribute resources accordingly. The data collected from the motion sensors provides better picture of when and where crowds are likely to move which can help derive insights from to help forecast the parking space occupancy, crowd concentrations, among many.
